title: Local SSD Space Reclamation & External Storage Archive Pipeline
hypothesis: Automating the identification of cold historical artifacts, legacy package caches, and oversized model checkpoints, paired with an external drive migration runbook, will reclaim >= 40 GiB on the 16GB M1 MacBook Pro internal drive without breaking git continuity or agent skill discovery.
falsification_criteria: Archive procedure breaks active APM skill symlinks, deletes unarchived source files, or reclaims < 15 GiB of storage.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Only escalate to cloud LLM if automated dependency resolution encounters circular symlink deadlock
